name: 10533 · Irvington, NY
findings: ZIP 10533 (Irvington) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10533 (Irvington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10533 (Irvington) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
